rewrites.comment: SPA fallback. Vercel serves a real file if one matches first, so /assets/* is untouched; /api/* is excluded so a missing backend returns 404 instead of HTML, which is far easier to diagnose.

headers.comment: On a static deploy there is no Express to run src/middleware/security.js, so these mirror the headers it sets. The strict script-src is the one that matters: the frontend ships no inline <script> and loads nothing from a CDN.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
